description: This file contains implementation of cryptographic big number exponentiation functions, including modular exponentiation routines such as BN_mod_exp and BN_mod_exp_recp, along with some internal support functions. It appears to be part of the OpenSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_simple(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs straightforward modular exponentiation when no special optimization is available.
